summary: A long established North Shore orthodontic practice appears to lose new patients to a 2016 footer, plain text phone number and no online booking.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read Copyright 2016.
findings.cost: A ten year old year makes a visitor wonder if the practice is still current.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: The phone number appears as plain text, not a tap to call link.
findings.cost: A parent on a phone has to copy the number instead of one tap to call.
findings.fix: Tap to call on every page.

findings.problem: No online booking form appears, only an Online Referral page and a Contact us page.
findings.cost: Families who want to book at night leave to find another practice.
findings.fix: A simple new patient booking form.

findings.problem: The text No results found appears on the page.
findings.cost: Stray messages make the site look neglected.
